summary: Davion Healthcare Plc furnished a Form -K announcing its ordinary shares are expected to begin trading on the Nasdaq Global Market on October 22, 2026 under ticker DAVI, with Maxim Group LLC as financial advisor on the listing. Concurrently, upon trading commencement, Glenn Williams becomes CEO and Jeremy North COO; Jack Kaye moves from CEO to Chairman (US$600,000 salary), Sir Eric Peacock steps down as Chairman but remains a non-executive director. A new Operational Directorate is established to oversee commercialization, distribution and acquisition evaluation. This is a listing and leadership-succession event, not a change-of-control special situation.
